items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 August 2026 5:46am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain at times, more persistent for the afternoon, clearing to become dry later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5.


##Wind Speed##

13


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

E 15-20, decreasing 10-15, occasionally 20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Dry and bright to start but soon turning cloudy with outbreaks of rain arriving in the afternoon. Small risk of thunder in the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

E or NE 10-15, occasionally 20, backing N or NE 5-10 in the afternoon, then backing NW 15, occasionally 20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Heavy rain at times, small risk of thunder later.


##Friday, 28 August 2026##

Any rain at first will soon clear to become largely dry with sunny intervals developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4 at first


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

N or NW 10-20, backing W or NW, becoming variable or SW 10 or less overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain at first. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 29 August 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain soon arriving, becoming dry later or overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4.


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Variable or SW 10 or less, soon settling E or SE 10-15, becoming cyclonic for a time, then becoming N or NW later. Backing W or SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 30 August 2026##

Sunny spells at first then turning cloudy with a spell of rain arriving in the afternoon which could be heavy at times.

5-10

15

SW

W or SW 10-15, soon backing S or SE, then increasing W or SW 20-25.

Good.
